start: Money, a fee was just collected from a member on a running plan

steps.action: Open the payment’s receipt
user_sees: Title 'Receipt <number>' with the member’s name and the day under it
Buttons 'Back', 'Send on WhatsApp', 'Print'
must_not: A receipt of another member
The words 'Receipt not found' for a payment just saved

steps.action: Read the sheet
user_sees: Heading 'Payment receipt' (or 'Tax invoice' when the gym had a GST number on the payment day)
'Received with thanks from' and the member’s name
'<Plan> membership' with '<first day> to <last day>' as sold
The amount, and in words like 'Rupees One Thousand Four Hundred Ninety Nine Only'
'Balance on this membership as on <today>:' with what is still due
'Computer-generated receipt. Valid without a signature.'
must_not: Words that do not match the figures
Free days given later printed as days paid for
GST worked out at today’s rate for an old payment
Today's GST number on a payment taken before the gym had one

steps.action: Tap 'Print'
user_sees: The browser’s print window with only the receipt sheet
must_not: The buttons or the menu printed on the paper
A different number on a second print

start: Receipt page of a live payment, member has a valid mobile number, internet on (other way: the receipt on WhatsApp)

steps.action: Tap 'Send on WhatsApp'
user_sees: WhatsApp opens in a new tab on the member’s number
Text: '<Hello name> we received your ₹<amount> on <day> (<method>). Receipt no. <number>. Received by <name>. Thank you!'
When money is still due: '₹<due> is still due.' with the gym’s UPI ID and pay link, then the gym’s sign-off line
must_not: The message sent by itself without the person pressing send in WhatsApp
Another member’s number
A still-due line when nothing is due

steps.action: Open a cancelled receipt, or go offline, or open one whose member has no valid number
user_sees: No 'Send on WhatsApp' link
must_not: A thank-you sent for a cancelled receipt

start: Collect fees across a year end and in a second branch (other kind: how the number is made)

steps.action: Collect a fee dated 31 March, then one dated 1 April
must_not: The new year carrying on from the old count
Two receipts with one number

steps.action: Collect a fee in an added branch
user_sees: A number that starts with the branch’s code, like 'B2/2026-27/0001'
must_not: The same number as a receipt of the first branch

steps.action: Bring in old payments with an import
user_sees: Their own series, like 'IMP/2026-27/0001'
must_not: Imported receipts taking numbers in the desk’s series
A number longer than 16 characters

start: Front desk device with no internet, a member pays (other kind: a receipt taken offline)

steps.action: Collect the fee offline
user_sees: A number from this device’s own series, like '2026-27/D1-0001'
must_not: A number that changes when the internet is back
The same number as another desk device

steps.action: Open a receipt whose save got no answer when the internet dropped
user_sees: 'Not confirmed yet: the internet dropped while this was saved. Its receipt number is sure once it is sent, so print it after that.'
'Print' is greyed
must_not: A print of a number that may still change

start: Collect dues sheet for a member who owes ₹500

steps.action: Type ₹600
user_sees: 'That is more than the ₹500 due on this membership.'
must_not: A receipt bigger than what is owed

steps.action: Type 0, then 10.555
user_sees: 'Type an amount more than zero, with at most two digits after the point.'
must_not: A receipt for zero
An amount rounded without a word

steps.action: Pick tomorrow as the payment day
user_sees: 'The payment date can’t be in the future.'
must_not: A receipt dated ahead

steps.action: Pick a day 90 days back
user_sees: The owner’s receipt is saved with that day
must_not: The 31-day limit of the front desk applied to the owner

steps.action: Open a receipt link of a payment that is not in this gym’s list
user_sees: 'Receipt not found'
'This receipt is not here any more. It may be from a gym you erased.'
Button 'Back to Money'
must_not: A blank page
Another gym's receipt

start: Collect dues sheet as front desk staff

steps.action: Pick a payment day 40 days back
user_sees: 'The front desk can date a payment at most 31 days back. Ask the owner to enter older payments.'
must_not: The receipt saved with the old day

steps.action: Pick tomorrow
user_sees: 'The payment date can’t be in the future.'
must_not: A receipt dated ahead

steps.action: Type more than is due on a fully paid plan
user_sees: 'This membership is fully paid. Nothing is due on it.'
must_not: A receipt on a plan that owes nothing

start: A receipt that was printed last month

steps.action: Cancel it and type the reason "x"
user_sees: 'Write why this receipt is cancelled (at least 3 letters), so it is clear later.'
must_not: A cancel saved with no real reason

steps.action: Type a real reason and cancel
user_sees: On the receipt: 'CANCELLED — THIS RECEIPT DOES NOT COUNT' with the reason
No 'Send on WhatsApp'
must_not: The cancelled money still in the totals
The receipt number used again for a new receipt

steps.action: Open another old receipt after the member got 3 free days and paid the rest
user_sees: The same number and the dates as sold
A line 'Extended free by 3 days (gift) to <day>'
The balance labelled 'as on <today>'
must_not: The old receipt saying the free days were paid for
A balance with no day, which would not match the copy handed over last month

start: A receipt the owner cancelled, opened by front desk staff

steps.action: Open the receipt
user_sees: 'CANCELLED — THIS RECEIPT DOES NOT COUNT' with the reason
No 'Send on WhatsApp'
must_not: The receipt looking valid on paper

steps.action: Look for a way to cancel or change another receipt
user_sees: None for the front desk
must_not: A cancel button for the front desk

steps.action: Read what the sheet shows about people
user_sees: The member’s name and mobile number, the gym’s name, address, phone and GST number, and who took the money
must_not: Other members’ payments
Health or body facts of the member

steps.action: Open the receipt from a link in a new tab and tap Back
user_sees: The Money page of the same gym
must_not: The panel left for an empty tab
The receipt shown to someone not signed in to this gym

steps.action: Send it on WhatsApp
user_sees: It goes only to the number on the member’s own record
must_not: The gym’s totals or another member’s dues in the message

start: Receipt page as front desk staff

steps.action: Open a receipt taken by the owner
user_sees: The same sheet as the owner sees for this one payment
must_not: Money totals of the gym
A list of all receipts with a sum

steps.action: Send it on WhatsApp
user_sees: It goes only to the member’s own number, with the staff person’s name as the one who received it only when the receipt carries it
must_not: The staff person’s own mobile number in the message
